instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor the AthleteCard component to look like a high-end physical sports trading card (FIFA Ultimate Team style) that evokes elite athleticism and luxury.
Remove the standard flat card layout. The entire card must be a single vertical canvas (e.g., 'aspect-[2.5/3.5]' or 'h-[26rem]') with the athlete bursting out from the bottom.
Do NOT use generic transparent backgrounds for the card base. Use an obsidian solid background (#0A0F1E) combined with inner gradients and the blurred athlete photo to create deep richness.
Implement a realistic foil/hologram sweep effect on hover using a sliding pseudo-element or absolute div (mix-blend-color-dodge with diagonal gradient).
Respect all data props strictly: full uncropped photo (object-contain over a blurred backdrop), top-right overall score, top-left rank medal, mini-bars for top_metrics, and all player info.
Ensure 'data-testid' is added or preserved on all interactive elements and key text nodes.

typography.primary_font: Use 'Outfit' or 'Barlow Condensed' for numbers, scores, and names. If missing, fallback to system sans-serif.
typography.metrics_label: text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-white/50

colors.accent_usage: Use the provided 'accent' prop (default #D4AF37) for the holographic sweep, metric progress bars, and icon tints.

card_container.structure: relative w-full aspect-[2.7/4] sm:h-[28rem] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-end group transition-all duration-500

photo_treatment.background_blur: absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover scale-125 blur-3xl opacity-40 mix-blend-screen
photo_treatment.main_image: absolute bottom-[25%] sm:bottom-[30%] left-0 right-0 w-full h-[70%] object-contain object-bottom drop-shadow-[0_15px_15px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] z-10 transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105

badges.overall_score: absolute top-3 right-3 z-30 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-2 rounded-b-xl border-t-2 shadow-xl backdrop-blur-md min-w-[3rem]
badges.rank_medal: absolute top-3 left-3 z-30 w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-black shadow-lg shadow-black/50 text-slate-900
badges.level_badge: relative z-30 mx-auto w-max px-3 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black tracking-widest border border-white/20 backdrop-blur-md mb-2 shadow-lg

info_panel.wrapper: relative z-20 w-full pt-20 pb-4 px-4 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050810] via-[#0A0F1E] to-transparent flex flex-col items-center
info_panel.player_details: flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-white/70 font-medium mb-3 flex-wrap
info_panel.metrics_grid: w-full grid gap-2 border-t border-white/10 pt-3 mt-1
info_panel.progress_bar_bg: w-full h-1 bg-white/10 rounded-full mt-1 overflow-hidden

holographic_foil.element: absolute inset-0 z-40 pointer-events-none opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-500
holographic_foil.style: bg-[linear-gradient(105deg,transparent_20%,rgba(255,255,255,0.4)_25%,rgba(212,175,55,0.5)_45%,transparent_50%)] bg-[length:250%_250%] bg-[0%_0%] group-hover:bg-[100%_100%] transition-[background-position] duration-700 ease-out mix-blend-overlay

metrics_implementation.logic: Map through top_metrics (slice to 3 max). Use style={{ gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${Math.min(a.top_metrics.length, 3)}, 1fr)` }}. Render label, value, and the mini progress bar.
metrics_implementation.bar_color: Use the 'accent' prop to color the filled portion of the mini progress bars.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT blindly center align text globally or in `.App`. Follow layout hierarchies.
Do NOT use full transparency for backgrounds containing text; always use a rich, dark backdrop or a strong gradient so text remains readable against the photo.
Do NOT remove the existing `onClick={onOpen}` logic on the AthleteCard.
Make sure `data-testid` is consistently applied to all interactive pieces.
Preserve the image fallback logic: if `has_photo` is false, render the initial letter.
Follow 'E1' principles: mix athleticism with luxury. Do not make it look like a boring Vercel template card.
